---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.30in, bottom: 0.48in, x: 0.42in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.6pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      [#link("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")[#text(fill: navy)[CC BY 4.0]] - share and adapt with attribution to Andrew Andrade: #link("https://github.com/mrandrewandrade")[#text(fill: navy)[https://github.com/mrandrewandrade]]],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"), size: 8.5pt, fill: charcoal, hyphenate: false)
#set par(leading: 0.48em, justify: false)

#let blank-field(label) = [
  #text(weight: "bold")[#label:]
  #h(5pt)
  #line(length: 1.8in, stroke: 0.55pt + slate)
]

#let page-header(side) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    align: horizon,
    [
      #text(size: 21pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[The Way We Meet - Listening Notes]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.8pt, fill: slate)[Attention, connection, and making space for one another - #side]
    ],
    [#text(size: 7.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]]
  )
  #v(3pt)
  #line(length: 0.58in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
  #v(4pt)
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 14pt,
    [#blank-field("Name")],
    [#blank-field("Class")],
    [#blank-field("Date")],
  )
  #v(4pt)
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    fill: sail,
    stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
    inset: (left: 9pt, right: 9pt, top: 4pt, bottom: 4pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 8pt)[Make space for each speaker: phones away unless directed otherwise, face the speaker, avoid side conversations, and write one brief note for every presenter. In the final column, circle #text(weight: "bold")[A] = Attentive, #text(weight: "bold")[S] = Some lapses, or #text(weight: "bold")[N] = Not attentive. Be honest: an honest S or N is better than a false A. Knowingly inaccurate self-ratings can reduce #text(weight: "bold")[Integrity & Reflection] more than the original lapse. #text(weight: "bold")[Submit this sheet after the final presentation day.]]
  ]
  #v(5pt)
]

#let notes-table(start, end) = table(
  columns: (0.34in, 1.28in, 3.05in, 3.35in, 1.78in),
  inset: (x: 4pt, y: 6.6pt),
  stroke: 0.55pt + mist,
  align: left + top,
  table.header(
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[No.]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Presenter]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Something I learned / noticed]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Connection, question, or comment]],
    [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[My attention]] #linebreak() #align(center)[#text(size: 7.2pt, fill: slate)[A / S / N]]],
  ),
  ..range(start, end + 1).map(n => (
    [#n], [], [], [], [#align(center)[A / S / N]],
  )).flatten()
)

#page-header([Side 1 - Presenters 1-17])
#notes-table(1, 17)

#pagebreak()
#page-header([Side 2 - Presenters 18-34])
#notes-table(18, 34)
```
